statement: For a playable Linux evdev-facing implementation, linux.uinput is the first candidate because it can expose the pinned kernel-declared buttons, sticks, hat and conventional FF shape without USB configuration exchange. This is an implementation recommendation, not a validated SDL Switch 2 native binding or a faithful retail representation. A faithful USB-consumer path would require a provider capable of a composite HID interface and vendor bulk configuration interface, such as an extended experimental dummy_hcd or USB/IP realization; UHID alone cannot create vendor-class bulk endpoints.
